correctness.rationale: The positive distinct cycle eigenvalues are Q-linearly independent: a relation would give a polynomial P of degree at most p−1 vanishing at a primitive pth root, with P(1)=0; divisibility by Φp and Φp(1)=p force P=0, whose disjoint nonconstant coefficients are the proposed relation coefficients. For a rational anisotropy, a cross-pair collision makes a/b a positive proportion of two nonzero differences of basis vectors (allow e0=0); the nonzero entries on both sides have modulus one, so a/b=1. Off E_p over the reals, cross-pair collision is excluded directly by its definition. At isotropy independence recovers the unordered multiset including zero (there are two labels total). Since p≥5 supplies two distinct positive indices, the largest eigenspace dimensions are exactly four off resonance and eight at isotropy. PBH for the real symmetric state matrix is equivalently injectivity of the complexified vertex restrictions. Two consecutive samples per coordinate give full column rank on each sign block. At isotropy, four distinct vertical roots at most can occur, their groups have at most two horizontal roots each, and consecutive vertical then horizontal Vandermonde evaluations separate all of them. This proves both patches and placement-independent lower bounds. The C6 example has a valid six-dimensional collision. Frozen floating-point diagnostics were inspected, not rerun; exact ranks and case boundaries here follow from the algebra.
